package.name: aav_rc_rs
package.description: rc_driver in Rust (rclrs): the default since 17 Nov (Ben: "Rust tomorrow"), beside aav_rc's Python one (rc_impl:=rust|python). The same node name, topic, QoS and parameters: /vehicle/rc (the RC's mode switch and sticks, from the ESP32's uplink) becomes /drivers/rc/cmd_vel while the mode switch is on RC via ROS. The rules are the rc-core crate, with no ROS, checked against rc_drive.py's answers.
